trajectory.development: Book 24 has a generation that came of age after Book 20 and has never seen the labour, because lineage crews perform it under the Right. The Brightwater inheritance splits into counted and uncounted practice within that one generation.
trajectory.becomes_available: Lineage crews carry channel repair from Book 20 under a Special Draw Right (E1), the arrangement that E6 gives as the reason this generation has not seen the labour.
trajectory.changes: Makes plural practice a matter across generations as well as communities, as E4 states. E4 is attributed unknown_legacy, so the provenance of the split is not established.
trajectory.quote: A generation that came of age after Book 20 has never seen the labour, because lineage crews perform it under the Right.

trajectory.development: Book 24 is where the labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule, and the Special Draw Right's review point falls in Book 24. Both placements are agent-proposed (E5, E7).
trajectory.becomes_available: The generation described in s1, which refuses to be counted, is asked to give back water before it is owed (agent-proposed in E5).
trajectory.changes: Turns repair from a lineage performance into a request made of people. The record does not date the Special Draw Right's review against the training condition (E3, E7).
trajectory.quote: Book 24 is where the Long Return's labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule.

trajectory.development: Outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right and their repair is demonstrated, so the condition the Right carries is tested (proposed).
trajectory.becomes_available: The Right's stated condition, training apprentices from outside the lineage (E7), becomes something that can be shown rather than only stated.
trajectory.changes: Without that demonstration the Right is exposed, as E3 states. E3 is agent-proposed.
trajectory.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.

trajectory.development: A public capability record, which E5 (agent-proposed) has Book 24 export as a new kind of record, is used to show who can repair, so repair is seen per person and not only counted (proposed).
trajectory.becomes_available: A record kept separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance, which says who can repair (E5).
trajectory.changes: If adopted, repair becomes visible per person. The cited items do not state that the record bears on any standing or coordination claim.
trajectory.quote: exports one new kind of record: a public capability record, separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance

trajectory.development: Possibility, not event: the cohort may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work, and Book 24 names no body that would grant that standing (E8, hypothetical).
trajectory.becomes_available: The cohort, which now practises both counted and uncounted return (E8), is the party that may claim standing in coordination. The record does not say how such a claim would be made.
trajectory.changes: Opens a question of who recognises a claim to coordinate channel work. Book 24 leaves that question unanswered, since it names and creates no grantor (E8).
trajectory.quote: may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work

relations.reason: E6 gives lineage crews' performance of the labour under the Right as the reason the later generation has not seen it. E1 records that arrangement from Book 20.
relations.quote: because lineage crews perform it under the Right

relations.reason: E5 (agent-proposed) ties the request for labour to a generation that refuses to be counted. The link is a proposal, not a recorded fact.
relations.quote: A generation that refuses to be counted is asked to give back the water before it is owed.

relations.reason: E3 (agent-proposed) says the Right is exposed unless the training condition is demonstrated. E7 places the review point in Book 24. The cited items do not state whether the demonstration comes before that review.
relations.quote: so they need the condition demonstrated or the Right is exposed

alternative_paths.ordering: Demonstrate outside apprenticeship before the Book 24 review, so the review tests a condition already shown.
alternative_paths.effect: On E3's condition, the Right is not exposed at review, because the condition is shown beforehand. The review stops testing an unmet condition.
alternative_paths.quote: so they need the condition demonstrated or the Right is exposed

alternative_paths.ordering: Standing is claimed without any public capability record (s4) being adopted.
alternative_paths.effect: Standing would rest on the split of practice alone (s1, E4, E8). The record names no grantor, so how standing would be recognised stays open.
alternative_paths.quote: Book 24 names no body that would grant that standing and creates none.

alternative_paths.ordering: The cohort practises both counted and uncounted return and never claims standing in channel coordination.
alternative_paths.effect: The split of practice (s1, E4) remains a fact of the valley's plural practice with no coordination claim. The standing possibility is simply not taken up.
alternative_paths.quote: may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work

opportunities.text: Proposed: if the capability record (s4) is adopted, the households that meet the rota could be seen for who they are, rather than only as the remainder that carries the work (E1).
opportunities.quote: households that can meet the rota carry the rest.

opportunities.text: Proposed: if the generation that has never seen the labour (s1) is asked to give back water before it is owed (s2), its first contact with the labour would be a demand, not an inherited practice.
opportunities.quote: A generation that refuses to be counted is asked to give back the water before it is owed.

opportunities.text: Proposed: if the review point (s2) falls before the training demonstration (s3), the review would test a condition not yet shown. That could make the Right's conditional nature visible to the valley.
opportunities.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.

reader_experience: A reader of Book 24 meets a generation that has never seen the labour and is then asked to give it back. The reader should not be told that standing has been claimed: the record writes it as a possibility, and marks the Book 24 placements as agent-proposed. The experience holds the question open rather than settling it.
open_decisions: Whether the Special Draw Right's review in Book 24 comes before or after outside apprentices are trained and their repair demonstrated.
Whether the public capability record (agent-proposed in E5) is adopted at all.
Whether the cohort's possible standing is recognised in coordination, and by which body, since Book 24 names none.
Whether Books 24 and 25 should keep identical text for these elements, since E14 shows the same text in both.
uncertainty: E5 is truncated after 'rather than who', so the rest of the capability-record sentence is not in evidence.
E4 is attributed unknown_legacy, so the provenance of the counted and uncounted split is not established.
No cited item states that practising both counted and uncounted return helps the standing claim, or that a repair record bears on it.
Books 24 and 25 carry the same text for these elements (E14), so the record does not separate them by content.

criticism_assessments.reason: The Book 24 review placement (E7) and the first-met-by-people line (E5) are agent-proposed, so the earlier basis of recorded was wrong. E1 supports only the Book 20 lineage arrangement. The corrected stage is labelled proposed.
E8 states only that the cohort 'may claim standing' and marks it hypothetical. The present-tense wording turned a possibility into an event. The split of practice (E4, E8) remains carried.
E8 and E4 place the split and the standing possibility side by side. No cited item states that practising both helps the claim as preparation. The preparation link is withdrawn.
E1 records repair by lineage crews, not a repair record. The repair record appears only in E5 (agent-proposed), and nothing cited links repair to standing. The repair-to-standing link is withdrawn.

changes_from_prior: c1 accepted: the labour-gap stage, now s2, is relabelled proposed because its Book 24 premises (E5, E7) are agent-proposed.
c2 accepted: the standing stage, now s5, is stated as a possibility ('may claim standing'), not an achieved event.
c3 and c4 accepted: the preparation link from split practice to standing and the repair-to-standing link are withdrawn, since no cited item states them.
Renumbered by dependency: the Book 24 generation stage is now s1, because E5 ties the labour request to a generation that refuses to be counted.
